    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【光照】UnityURP[光照贴图]GPU instancing在静态动态物体上的应用</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3685400/202510/3685400-20251010103346063-702290258.png" alt="【光照】UnityURP[光照贴图]GPU instancing在静态动态物体上的应用" class="desc_img">
        该专栏探讨了Unity URP中静态和动态物体的GPU实例化技术要点。对于静态物体，需标记为BatchingStatic并禁用静态合批，通过LightmapIndex绑定光照贴图，在着色器中添加实例化支持。动态物体则依赖光照探针获取间接光照，使用MaterialPropertyBlock传递探针数据。文章提供了StaticInstancingExample和DynamicInstancingExample两个示例代码，展示如何实现矩阵变换和光照数据传递。在Shader适配方面，需处理光照贴图采样和探针数据，
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://blog.csdn.net/chenghai37/category_13021255.html?fromshare=blogcolumn&amp;sharetype=blogcolumn&amp;sharerId=13021255&amp;sharerefer=PC&amp;sharesource=chenghai37&amp;sharefrom=from_link" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">【从UnityURP开始探索游戏渲染】</a><strong>专栏-直达</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="静态物体gpu-instancing与光照贴图"><strong>静态物体GPU Instancing与光照贴图</strong></h1>
<h2 id="技术要点">‌<strong>技术要点</strong>‌：</h2>
<ul>
<li>‌<strong>静态标记</strong>‌：物体需标记为<code>Batching Static</code>，但需禁用静态合批以避免与GPU Instancing冲突。</li>
<li>‌<strong>光照贴图绑定</strong>‌：通过<code>LightmapIndex</code>和<code>LightmapScaleOffset</code>手动绑定烘焙结果。</li>
<li>‌<strong>Shader适配</strong>‌：需在着色器中添加实例化支持与光照贴图采样逻辑。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="示例代码">‌<strong>示例代码</strong>‌：</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>StaticInstancingExample.cs</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using UnityEngine;

[ExecuteAlways]
public class StaticInstancingExample : MonoBehaviour {
    public Mesh mesh;
    public Material material;
    public int instanceCount = 100;
    private Matrix4x4[] matrices;
    private Vector4[] lightmapOffsets;

    void Start() {
        // 生成实例变换矩阵
        matrices = new Matrix4x4[instanceCount];
        lightmapOffsets = new Vector4[instanceCount];
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; instanceCount; i++) {
            Vector3 pos = Random.insideUnitSphere * 10f;
            matrices[i] = Matrix4x4.TRS(pos, Quaternion.identity, Vector3.one);

            // 模拟不同光照贴图偏移（需与烘焙数据匹配）
            lightmapOffsets[i] = new Vector4(1, 1, i % 2 * 0.5f, i / 2 * 0.5f);
        }
    }

    void Update() {
        MaterialPropertyBlock props = new MaterialPropertyBlock();
        props.SetVectorArray("_LightmapST", lightmapOffsets); // 传递光照贴图UV偏移
        Graphics.DrawMeshInstanced(mesh, 0, material, matrices, instanceCount, props);
    }
}
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="实现说明">‌<strong>实现说明</strong>‌：</h2>
<ul>
<li>使用<code>MaterialPropertyBlock</code>传递每实例的光照贴图UV偏移参数。</li>
<li>着色器中需声明<code>UNITY_LIGHTMAP_ON</code>宏并采样<code>unity_Lightmap</code>纹理。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h1 id="动态物体gpu-instancing与光照探针"><strong>动态物体GPU Instancing与光照探针</strong></h1>
<h2 id="技术要点-1">‌<strong>技术要点</strong>‌：</h2>
<ul>
<li>‌<strong>光照探针替代</strong>‌：动态物体依赖<code>Light Probes</code>获取间接光照。</li>
<li>‌<strong>混合光源支持</strong>‌：光源设为<code>Mixed</code>模式，静态阴影烘焙到光照贴图，动态物体接收实时阴影。</li>
<li>‌<strong>实例化属性扩展</strong>‌：通过<code>MaterialPropertyBlock</code>传递探针数据。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="示例代码-1">‌<strong>示例代码</strong>‌：</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>DynamicInstancingExample.cs</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using UnityEngine;

public class DynamicInstancingExample : MonoBehaviour {
    public Mesh mesh;
    public Material material;
    public int instanceCount = 100;
    private Matrix4x4[] matrices;

    void Start() {
        matrices = new Matrix4x4[instanceCount];
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; instanceCount; i++) {
            Vector3 pos = Random.insideUnitSphere * 10f;
            matrices[i] = Matrix4x4.TRS(pos, Quaternion.identity, Vector3.one);
        }
    }

    void Update() {
        MaterialPropertyBlock props = new MaterialPropertyBlock();

        // 为每个实例设置光照探针数据
        LightProbes.GetInterpolatedProbe(transform.position, null, out var probe);
        props.AddVector("_LightProbeData", new Vector4(probe.occlusion, 0, 0, 0));

        Graphics.DrawMeshInstanced(mesh, 0, material, matrices, instanceCount, props);
    }
}
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="实现说明-1">‌<strong>实现说明</strong>‌：</h2>
<ul>
<li>通过<code>LightProbes.GetInterpolatedProbe</code>获取动态物体的光照探针数据。</li>
<li>着色器中需使用<code>SHADERGRAPH_BAKED_LIGHT_PROBES</code>宏处理探针数据。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h1 id="shader适配关键代码urp-shader-graph"><strong>Shader适配关键代码（URP Shader Graph）</strong></h1>
<ul>
<li>‌<strong>静态光照贴图采样</strong>‌：在Shader Graph中添加<code>Lightmap</code>节点，并通过<code>Custom Function</code>节点接入实例化的UV偏移参数。</li>
<li>‌<strong>动态探针支持</strong>‌：添加<code>Baked Light Probes</code>节点，并与实例化属性<code>_LightProbeData</code>关联。</li>
</ul>
<p>‌<strong>优先级注意</strong>‌：若同时启用SRP Batcher，需确保材质兼容性（禁用<code>MaterialPropertyBlock</code>）</p>
